name: Go
ffi: purego (github.com/ebitengine/purego): no cgo, no C compiler
needs: Go 1.21 or newer, network access once to fetch purego and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: Loads the library with purego, so no C compiler is needed to build your program. Linux and macOS only in this binding: on Windows use `syscall.LoadLibrary` instead of `purego.Dlopen`.
The library is looked for in `$PEEP_LIB`, then the current directory, then next to the executable.
`Read` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: demo: decodes the test files and prints checksums
